caseName: Jones v. Jackson, Judge, United States District Court for the District of Columbia
caseNameFull: Jones v. Jackson, Judge, United States District Court for the District of Columbia, Et Al.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of petitioner for reconsideration of order denying leave to proceed in forma pauperis [ante, p. 808] denied. Justice Ginsburg took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
